description_en: Queries the initialization status. This is an earlier version of the operation
name: DescribeInitializationStatus

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the data synchronization instance resides. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.help_zh: 数据同步实例所在地域的ID，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data synchronization instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/49454.html operation to query the instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 数据同步实例ID，可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/49454.html接口查询
parameters.name: synchronization_job_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh: 每页记录数，取值：1~100，默认值为30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be greater than 0 and cannot exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值为大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_num

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter. This parameter will be discontinued
parameters.help_zh: 阿里云主账号ID，无需设置，该参数即将下线
parameters.name: account_id
